The first Ryzen AI 470 mini PC is here — and the Minisforum AI X1 Pro 470 packs OCuLink, USB4, and up to 12TB of NVMe storage.
I tested gaming, benchmarks, power draw, thermals, and real local AI workloads on the Radeon 890M + XDNA NPU.

Learn More Here: https://tidd.ly/4kj6hEP
